title: Flow State project configuration
description: flow.config.json at the project root, merged with a git-ignored flow.config.user.json. Scalars override; arrays of objects with a `name` merge by name; other arrays append.

autonomy.description: gated: stop at every checkpoint. assisted: stop only at the three gates (freeze, go, merge). auto: build runs unattended and halts with a reason instead of asking; freeze and merge remain human.
autonomy.x-question: How much should Flow State ask? assisted: stops at freeze, go, merge and when stuck. gated: every checkpoint. auto: a build halts instead of asking.

family.description: flat: capitalised root files (README, CHANGELOG, DECISIONS, TECH_SPEC). numbered: docs/01_USER_SPEC.md style. custom: use docs.map.

lenses.description: Project review lenses the review stage may invoke by trigger.

source.x-question: Where do tickets live? github, linear, jira, or none. Seeds a required integration.

rules.description: Repository rule files pasted into every brief and package. Defaults: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md (+imports), .claude/rules, .cursor/rules, Copilot instructions, GEMINI.md, CONTRIBUTING.md.

include.description: Extra rule files, paths relative to the project root.

maxBytes.description: Budget for pasted rules, as a string number. Default 32768.

ship.description: How this repository ships. Discovered and asked by flow setup; followed by flow ship.

verify.description: Build, lint and test command run before the merge gate.

smoke.description: Optional production or staging smoke command.

branching.description: trunk: push to the default branch is the merge. branches: feature branches with a pull request.

branchPattern.description: Feature branch naming, e.g. feat/<slug> or <ticket>-<slug>.

template.description: Path to the PR template, if any.

requiredChecks.description: CI check names that must be green.

reviewers.description: Who must review: usernames, teams, or CODEOWNERS.

draft.x-question: Open pull requests as drafts, so you mark them ready?

deploy.description: How a merge reaches production: 'automatic on merge', a command, a release tag pattern, a train.

release.description: Versioning and release notes rule, e.g. 'SemVer in package.json, CHANGELOG Unreleased, tag vX.Y.Z'.

done.description: Definition of done beyond green tests.

doc.description: Path to the project's design system document that flow-design treats as law.

roles.description: Teach the agents: per-role notes this project keeps, appended to the builder's brief and handed to the judge, the spec reviewer and the architect by path.

dir.description: Folder holding flow-builder.md, flow-judge.md, flow-spec-reviewer.md, flow-architect.md, flow-researcher.md as the project wants them.

comment.x-question: After a review: post the findings on the PR as one comment, draft them for you to paste, or keep them in the story file?

approve.x-question: May Flow State approve a PR when nothing high or medium remains? It counts as your approval; merging is never automated.

native.x-question: Run the host tool's own review (/code-review, /security-review, Codex review-agent, Cursor review, Copilot review) beside the judge?

policy.x-question: When a newer Flow State exists: ask before updating, only tell you, or stay silent?

source.x-question: Which repository holds your team's Flow State? Keep the default unless your company runs its own.

integrations.x-question: Which systems does this loop need (ticket system, chat, analytics, design)? Found ones are proposed; a company's own needs a kind.

exclude.x-question: Any Flow State convention this repository should not apply (simplicity, boundaries, testing, ui-states, no-hardcoding, docs-update-law)?

welcomed.description: The version that welcomed this machine; set by the first run.
